label: Media Archive
positive_tail: archival documentary still, careful restoration texture, tactile paper and film materials, grounded natural lighting
image_grade_tail: subtle archival patina, clean readable composition
portrait_look: period-accurate costume and setting, grounded natural lighting, restored archival photograph texture
portrait_look_talking: period-accurate costume, warm natural window light
portrait_instruction_look: documentary-real and period-consistent, like a carefully restored archival photograph
scene_instruction_look: grounded archival documentary scene, restored period photograph look
announcer_subject_face: its glowing tuning dial forming a subtle expressive face -- two round dial-eyes and a modest needle-fan mouth, an anthropomorphic period radio that hosts the broadcast
announcer_subject_ltx_mouth: {form} as a living period appliance face: its wide woven speaker grille bends into a huge expressive rubbery mouth, big lips molded from grille cloth and worn wood, open mid-speech, and its two round glass tuning dials are its eyes -- a face-forward anthropomorphic radio of aged bakelite, wood and tarnished chrome, the radio cabinet itself filling the frame
announcer_subject_object: presented as a carefully preserved tabletop radio set on its plate, its aged bakelite cabinet, worn woven speaker grille and a softly glowing tuning dial
plate_look: authentic period set, archival restoration texture
non_character_emblem_fallback: a single period-authentic emblematic object representing {base}
still_word_title_mood_style: abstract restored-archival mood image, muted tactile paper and light textures in a symbolic non-literal composition, no lettering

open_subjects.synthetic: {form} warming up on a table, softly glowing dials and tubes, warm filament glow in natural light
open_subjects.announcer: {form} in a modest broadcast booth, glowing warmly, lit dials and tubes under natural light
open_subjects.default: {form} glowing warmly, aged vacuum tubes and worn dials

motion_registers.announcer: Continuous shot, same console throughout. Tuning dial needle drifts steadily. Tubes glow and breathe. Dust motes float in window light.
motion_registers.music_open: Continuous shot, same console throughout. Dial sweeps across frequencies. Tube filaments warm from cold to bright. Grille cloth trembles gently.
motion_registers.music_close: Continuous shot, same console throughout. Dial settles. Tube filaments fade through deep amber. A last curl of dust drifts down.
motion_registers.music_inter: Continuous shot, same console throughout. Dial steady, glowing. Needle quivers with the rhythm. Tubes pulse softly.
